scope: Official chain directories; missing coordinates, conflicting source pins and ambiguous matches are withheld. Not a complete city inventory. Explicit suburb/settlement names remain accurate instead of being labelled Tbilisi.

matchingPolicy.exactBrandAddress: Same reviewed brand plus exact street surname and house number; coordinates agree within 200m where supplied.
matchingPolicy.uniqueBrandPoint: Same reviewed brand and category; sole candidate within 25m, next same-brand candidate beyond 60m.
matchingPolicy.buildingAnchor: Official street and house number exactly match an OSM address object; unique address anchor or co-located address objects within 20m. Building center accuracy is disclosed.
matchingPolicy.nearMatchUnresolved: Same-brand candidates within 125m without stronger identity evidence are held for review.
